name: Consensus
description: AI, Research and Media-native: AI academic search engine over peer-reviewed papers, with an application-gated search API and an official OAuth MCP server.
access_notes: A public API does exist (documented at docs.consensus.app, e.g. GET /v1/quick_search with x-api-key header), but 'The Consensus API is available by application only' with custom quotes (baseline $0.10/call plus platform fee) — no self-serve key generation. The MCP server, by contrast, is self-serve for Consensus users via OAuth; enterprise MCP access uses an API key as a Bearer token.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP server at https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp documented at docs.consensus.app/docs/mcp; OAuth in Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor/Codex, Bearer API key for enterprise clients. No Composio toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/consensus.md returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: The documented REST surface is essentially paper search (quick_search) — read-only and narrow. OAuth is only used for the MCP connector, not the REST API. No webhook documentation found. The hint 'OAuth requested' matches the MCP OAuth flow; direct API remains application-gated.
